paite: Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei. Dan chite’n gam luah ding azong uhi. Israel chite lak ah gam luah ding atang nai kei uhi.
heading: Mikah Leh Dan Nam

paite: Dan suante'n anam pumpi lak ua mi, pasalpha nga, Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan gam enkhe ding leh va entel ding in mi asawl uhi. Akiang uah, "Va kuan unla, gam va entel dih ua," achi uhi. Huchi in Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung ua, huai ah agiak uhi.
Mikah inn kiang a a-om lai un, Levi chi tangval aw athei ua, huai lam ava zuan ua, akiang ah, "Hiai a hon pi kua ahia? Hiai mun ah bang ahia na hih? Bangchi in ahia hiai a na ten?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Mikah in huchi in ahon na bawlta a, ahon guai a, asiampu in ka om hi," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Ka hohna ding uah ka lamzang ding uh hia ding lou, chih theihtheihna ding in Pathian hon dotsak dih ve," achi uhi.
Siampu in akiang uah, "Lungmuangtak in pai un. Na hohna ding ma uah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.

Huchi in mi ngate apawtkhia ua, Laish ah alut ua, huai mite Zidon mite mah bang a galmuangtak leh lungmuangtak a om hithiat a om ava mu ua; amaute zahlaksak ding thuneimi kuamah a-om kei a, Zidonte toh akigamla ua, kuamah toh leng akisai kha kei uhi.
Zorah leh Eshtaol ah a-unaute uh kiang ah ahong pai ua; a-unaute un akiang uah, "Bangchi ahia oi?" achi uhi.
Amau, "Thou dih ua, i sual ding uh. Gam ahihleh ka va mu ngei ua, ngai un, ahoih mahmah hi. Dai maimah ding na hi uhia? Huai gam va lut a, va luah ding in zekai kei dih uh.
Va hoh le uchin galmuang a om mite ahi chih na va mu ding uh; agam lah aza mahmah ngal a. Pathian in nou ahon pe khinta hi. Lei a thil om ah zaw bangmah taksap ding a-om hetlouhna mun ahi," achi uhi.
Huchi in Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan Dan namte kidouna galthuam silh in mi zaguk apawt uhi.
Ava hohtou ua, Judah gam Kiriath-jearim ah om mun abawl uh. Huaiziak in huai mun tuni tan in Mananeh Dan achi lai ua, Kiriath-jearim tang lam a om ahi.
Huai a pan Ephraim tanggam lam azuan ua, Mikah inn ava tung uhi.

Huchi in Laish gam enkhe dia mi nga pawtte'n adawng ua, a-unaute uh kiang ah, "Hiai innte ah ephod, milimte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte a-om chih na thei uhia? Huchi bangchi in ahia na hih ding uh ngaihtuah un," achi uhi,
Huai a pan apai ua, Levi chi tangval omna Mikah inn ngei ava tung ua, atungtang thu adong uhi.
Dan suan mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte kulh kongpi bul ah adingh uhi.
Mi nga gam enkhete ava hohtou ua, alut ua, milim bawltawm, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ala ua, mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte lak ah kulh kongpi bul ah siampu adingh hi.
Huaite Mikah inn ah ava lut ua, bawltawm milimte, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ava lak uleh, siampu in akiang uah, "Hiai a bang hih na mai ua?" achi hi.

Amau, "Dai in, na khut in na muk hum inla, ka kiang uah hong pai inla, ka pa uh leh siampu ding un hong om in. Nang a ding in inn khat kia siampu a om hia hoihzaw, Israel lak a chi khat leh nam khat siampu dia om?" achi uhi.
Siampu lungtang akipak mahmah a, huchi in ephod, milim leh bawltawm milimte ala a, mipite lak ah a-omta hi.
Huchi in apaikhia ua, anau neute uh, gante uh leh avante uh amasuan tou zel uh.
Mikah inn a pan gamla kuam apaikhiak nung un Mikah invengte akikaikhawm ua, Dan suante adelhphata uhi.
Dan suante asam uhi. Amau anunglam anga ua, Mikah kiang ah, "Bang achia ahia, mi huai zahzah na hon tonpih?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Ka bawl pathiante leh siampu na paipih ua, na pai vengveng ua, bang ka nei lai a? Bangziak a bangchi na hia, na hon chih uh?" achi hi.
Dan suante'n akiang ah, "Ka lak uah pau mawkmawk kei dih aw, huchi lou in zaw mithangpai khut na thuak kha dia, na inkote toh na hinna na tan ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Dan suante apai ua, Mikah in lah sual ngam vual hi un athei kei a, a-inn lam ah apai nawnta hi.
Mikah thilbawlte leh asiampu neih apaipih ua, Laish khua, galmuang a om hithiatte kiang atungtou ua, namsau in athat ua; mei in khua ahalta uh.
Zidon a pan agamlat mahmah ziak in va hunkhe ding mi kuamah a-om kei, akuakua toh kizatna mahmah anei kei uh. Beth-rehob kiang a om phaizang ahi a, khopi khat alam ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
Akho min Israel tapa, apu uh Dan tam in, Dan asa uhi. Himahleh atung in huai kho min Laish ahi.
Dan suante'n huai milim bawltawm adingkhesakta ua, Mosi tapa Gershon tapa Jonathan leh atapate, gam sal a pi ahih masiah uh Dan chite siampu ahita uhi.
Huchi in Mikah bawltawm milim ahihleh Shiloh a Pathian inn a a-om lai teng adingsak uhi.
